reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: סדרה מושלמת וסרום מדהים, גם ההשפעה של התכשיר וגם האריזה עצמה נוחה לשימוש, ומספיק להרבה זמן. אני כבר 3 חודשים משתמשת כמעט פעם ביום ונשאר חצי מהצנצנת. ממליצה בחום לעור רגיל עד מעורב. ריח ומרקם גם מושלמים
reviews.zh: 完美嘅系列，支精華亦都超讚，產品本身嘅效果同包裝都好方便用，而且份量好襟用。我已經用咗3個月，幾乎日日用，仲剩返半枝。強烈推薦畀中性至混合性膚質。味道同質地都好完美。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: This is a repurchase. Love this serum as a layer under tret or over tret as a pre moisturiser top up. I also use it when my skins feeling a bit over exfoliated or peeling or just generally when it looks like it could do with an extra hit of nourishment. Also strangely cooling?? Love it.
reviews.zh: 呢個係回購。我好鍾意用呢支精華疊喺tret底下或者tret上面當保濕前打底。當皮膚覺得過度去角質、甩皮，又或者整體需要多啲滋養嘅時候我都會用。仲有就係用落有種好奇怪嘅涼快感？？真係好鍾意。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: Amazing! The texture of this is so nourishing. It feels calming and protective. I had over exfoliated and this layered over my hydrating serums and before moisturiser is perfect. The backup is already in my cart.
reviews.zh: 超正！質地好有滋養感。用落覺得舒緩又有保護性。我之前過度去角質，喺保濕精華上面、保濕霜之前疊一層呢個就剛剛好。已經將後備加入購物車。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: Great active ingredient, great consistency. I use it with toner, especially on days when I'm doing a little less skincare and want to give my skin a little more rest. So after cleansing, I just use this serum with toner and a barrier cream, nothing else. I'll be reordering it.
reviews.zh: 活性成分出色，質地都好。我會配爽膚水用，尤其係想畀皮膚抖下、護膚步驟減半嘅日子。潔面之後我就只用呢支精華加爽膚水同一枝屏障霜，乜都唔加。一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: I’ve noticed that my skin feels calmer and less irritated after using this serum, especially on days when my skin is feeling stressed or reactive. While it’s not a miracle worker for severe redness or dryness, it does a solid job of keeping my skin balanced and comfortable.
reviews.zh: 用完呢支精華我留意到皮膚冇咁繃緊、冇咁容易敏感，尤其係皮膚狀態唔穩、容易反應過度嘅日子。雖然對於嚴重泛紅或者乾燥佢唔係仙丹，但平衡同舒適感方面佢真係做得幾穩陣。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: So happy they finally changed this to a pump dispenser! Some by mi pipets are awful and never worked. Hope they also change the retinol to a pump too!
reviews.zh: 佢哋終於改做按壓式包裝，真係超開心！Some by mi 嘅滴管真係爛到用唔到。希望佢哋都會將支retinol都改做按壓式！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Serum 30mL
reviews.text: Gran efecto calmante que fortalece la barrera de la piel, gracias al pantenol y probióticos. Textura ligera de rápida absorción que hidrata hasta durante 100 horas.
reviews.zh: 舒緩效果強勁，可以強化皮膚屏障，全靠泛醇同益生菌。質地輕盈、吸收快，保濕可以維持長達100小時。
